ideal: Alphabet fell 12.64% while the S&P 500 fell 0.38%, the same day it filed its 10-Q. Lilly rose 6.63% and Amazon fell 4.25% on earnings 8-Ks. Meta's 8-K covers a material agreement and changes to shareholder rights and bylaws, with links; the 8-A12B and the proxy filing are skipped.
